title: SHERLOC: Structured Diagnostic Localization for Code Repair Agents
title_zh: SHERLOC：面向代码修复 Agent 的结构化诊断式定位框架
abstract_en: LLM agents solve repository-level coding tasks through multi-turn tool use, but utilize half their budget on locating faults before editing. Dedicated localization frameworks have emerged, yet are still evaluated as file retrieval rather than actionable diagnosis, producing locations without the diagnostic context a repair agent needs. We introduce SHERLOC (Structured Hypothesis-driven Exploration and Reasoning for Localization), a training-free framework pairing a reasoning LLM with compact repository tools and self-recovery, without fine-tuning or multi-agent orchestration. SHERLOC reaches state-of-the-art localization across model scales: 84.33% accuracy@1 on SWE-Bench Lite and 81.27% recall@1 on SWE-Bench Verified; at ~30B parameters, it matches or outperforms other agentic methods. Injecting our locations and diagnostic findings into repair agents yields, on average, +5.95 pp resolve rate on SWE-Bench Verified while cutting localization and total tokens by 36.7% and 23.1%.
abstract_zh: LLM agents 在解决 repository-level 代码任务时通常依赖多轮工具调用，但约一半预算消耗在编辑前的缺陷定位上。现有专门的 localization 框架多被评估为文件检索任务，输出位置却缺少修复 agent 所需的诊断上下文。本文提出 SHERLOC（Structured Hypothesis-driven Exploration and Reasoning for Localization），一个无需训练的框架，将推理型 LLM、紧凑的代码库工具与自恢复机制结合起来，不需要 fine-tuning 或多 agent 编排。SHERLOC 在不同模型规模上达到领先的定位性能：在 SWE-Bench Lite 上取得 84.33% accuracy@1，在 SWE-Bench Verified 上取得 81.27% recall@1；约 30B 参数规模下即可匹配或超过其他 agentic 方法。将 SHERLOC 生成的位置与诊断发现注入代码修复 agent 后，在 SWE-Bench Verified 上平均提升 5.95 个百分点的 resolve rate，同时将定位 token 与总 token 分别减少 36.7% 和 23.1%。
key_points_zh: 提出 SHERLOC，将缺陷定位从单纯 file retrieval 提升为面向修复的结构化诊断，输出位置同时提供诊断上下文。
框架无需 fine-tuning，也不依赖 multi-agent orchestration，而是结合 reasoning LLM、紧凑 repository tools 与 self-recovery。
在 SWE-Bench Lite 上达到 84.33% accuracy@1，在 SWE-Bench Verified 上达到 81.27% recall@1，表现为 state-of-the-art。
约 30B 参数模型规模下，SHERLOC 即可匹配或超越其他 agentic localization 方法。
将其定位与诊断结果注入 repair agents 后，SWE-Bench Verified 平均 resolve rate 提升 5.95 pp，并减少 36.7% 定位 token 和 23.1% 总 token。

llm_assessment.comment: SHERLOC improves code-agent localization and repair efficiency, but it is more of a task-specific diagnostic module than a broad harness contribution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: SHERLOC提升了代码智能体的定位和修复效率，但更像任务专用诊断模块，而非广泛的智能体底座贡献。
